Questions drivers ask

Where is HX Auto Service?

At 47 Jalan Indah 16/11, Taman Bukit Indah, 79100 Iskandar Puteri, Johor Bahru. The workshop is close to the Second Link.

What are your opening hours?

On Google: Monday to Saturday 9:30am to 7:30pm, Thursday from 9:00am, and Sunday closed.

Do Singapore cars come here?

Yes. Many of the cars in our workshop photos carry Singapore plates. WhatsApp us before you cross so we can plan the bay.

How do I book?

WhatsApp 011-6776 1138 with your car model, year and what you notice. You can also call the same number.
